title: GridSim v1 buses.json
description: The buses of the case, one record each. Required file: the loader refuses a case without buses. Member names are case-sensitive here (canonical camelCase spelling), although the v1 loader matches them ignoring case: the case editor refuses to save a non-canonical spelling until it is normalised (Q1, strict). Unknown members are refused, as the loader refuses them (R268). JSON null is refused everywhere: the loader reads null as absent, and the editor removes a member rather than writing null. Numeric ranges mirror the v2 network schema, so a v1 case the editor saves always projects to a valid v2 network. Rules a schema cannot express (bus references resolving, ZIP triples summing to 1, the [VERIFY] honesty rule) are the loader's.

bus.title: Bus
bus.description: A bus (v1 BusDto). baseKv is REQUIRED (R179 / Q13: it no longer defaults to 400 kV). Absent: type pq, vm 1, vaDeg/gs/bs/x/y 0, no name, no zip. The bus type is normally derived: any generator raises its bus to pv, a slack generator makes it slack.

id.title: Bus id
id.description: The bus number every other file refers to. Must be unique in the case.

baseKv.title: Base voltage (kV)
baseKv.description: Nominal line-to-line voltage of the bus. Required: it scales every kA figure of a fault study.

type.title: Bus type
type.description: pq (load), pv (voltage-controlled) or slack (reference). The loader also accepts its aliases ref and swing (slack) and gen (pv), and these are allowed here; the loader refuses any other word, and a null, since October 2026 (N096 / N098), as this schema does. Absent: pq, raised by the generators at the bus.

vm.title: Voltage magnitude (pu)
vm.description: Initial or scheduled voltage magnitude. Absent: 1.0 pu.

gs.title: Shunt conductance (MW at 1 pu)
gs.description: Shunt conductance, as MW consumed at 1.0 pu voltage. Absent: 0.

bs.title: Shunt susceptance (Mvar at 1 pu)
bs.description: Shunt susceptance, as Mvar injected at 1.0 pu voltage. Absent: 0.

x.title: Layout x
x.description: Layout coordinate (0..1) for the visualiser. Absent: 0.

y.title: Layout y
y.description: Layout coordinate (0..1) for the visualiser. Absent: 0.

zip.title: ZIP load model
zip.description: Voltage-dependent load model for the demand at this bus. Absent: constant power.

vminPu.title: Own lower voltage limit (pu)
vminPu.description: This bus's own lower voltage limit (F17; MATPOWER column 13). Used only when per-bus limits are asked for (--bus-vlimits). Absent: the global band.

vmaxPu.title: Own upper voltage limit (pu)
vmaxPu.description: This bus's own upper voltage limit (F17; MATPOWER column 12). Used only when per-bus limits are asked for (--bus-vlimits). Absent: the global band.

zip.title: ZIP load model
zip.description: Voltage-dependent load at the bus (v1 BusZipDto): P(V) = Pd (ap V^2 + bp V + cp), Q(V) = Qd (aq V^2 + bq V + cq), V in pu. All six coefficients are required (the loader refuses a missing one); the rule that each triple sums to 1 within 1e-9 is checked by the loader (JsonGridLoader.ParseZip). Absent block: constant power.

ap.title: ap: constant-impedance share of P
ap.description: Share of the real power that scales with V^2.

bp.title: bp: constant-current share of P
bp.description: Share of the real power that scales with V.

cp.title: cp: constant-power share of P
cp.description: Share of the real power independent of V.

aq.title: aq: constant-impedance share of Q
aq.description: Share of the reactive power that scales with V^2.

bq.title: bq: constant-current share of Q
bq.description: Share of the reactive power that scales with V.

cq.title: cq: constant-power share of Q
cq.description: Share of the reactive power independent of V.
